sources.title: GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF is designed for use with GGML and other executors. GGUF was developed by @ggerganovwho is also the developer of llama.cpp, a popular C/C++ LLM inference framework. Models initially developed in frameworks like PyTorch can be converted to GGUF format for use with those engines.
